content_sections.heading: IISER Bhopal Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. IISERB/DoFA/2026/32 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download IISER Bhopal notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: PhD in any branch of life sciences from a reputed university / institution; Ph.D. scholars after submission of Thesis are also eligible; provisional/degree certificate must be submitted within 6 months from the date of appointment Experience: Candidates with experience in the area of epigenetics, lipids and proteins metabolism in yeast will be given preference Age limit: Below 35 years (as on the last date of submission of application) Other conditions: Open to Indian Nationals Medical insurance policy of minimum Rs. 1 lakh in own name, valid throughout the Fellowship, is mandatory Expected to assist in teaching course(s) besides research work Desirable: Experience in the area of epigenetics, lipids and proteins metabolism in yeast

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initially for one year with the possibility of extension for another year based on satisfactory performance Thesis-submitted candidates must submit the provisional/degree certificate within 6 months from appointment, else the appointment will stand cancelled or a decision will be taken in consultation with the thesis processing authority

content_sections.heading: How Will IISER Bhopal Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting Interview Mere fulfilling of eligibility criteria will not entitle any candidate to be called for interview Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Completed application form (in PDF format) as per Annexure-I Latest Curriculum Vitae (CV) A comprehensive list of publications A detailed research plan for one year (maximum two pages) Scanned copy of Ph.D. Degree certificate OR Ph.D. Thesis submission receipt, if the degree is yet to be awarded

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISER Bhopal Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Send the documents by email to [email protected] on or before November 25, 2026. Write the subject line as "Application for the post of Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow (Biological Sciences)". Attach the completed application form (in PDF format) as per Annexure-I. Attach latest Curriculum Vitae (CV) and a comprehensive list of publications. Attach a detailed research plan for one year (maximum two pages). Attach a scanned copy of Ph.D. Degree certificate OR Ph.D. Thesis submission receipt. Email it on or before 25 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications will not be processed No interim enquiries/correspondence/communication of any sort will be entertained No accommodation will be provided to the IPDFs No medical reimbursement will be admissible Leave and OPD medical facility as applicable to PG students, as laid down in the PG Manual

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IISER Bhopal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IISER Bhopal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow (IPDF).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IISER Bhopal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 25 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 35 years (as on the last date of submission of application).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 67,000 per month + HRA; Rs. 35,000 per month + HRA until the PhD degree is awarded for thesis-submitted candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: PhD in any branch of life sciences from a reputed university / institution. Ph.D. scholars who have submitted their thesis are also eligible. Experience in epigenetics, lipids and proteins metabolism in yeast is preferred.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open to Indian Nationals. Medical insurance policy of minimum Rs. 1 lakh in own name, valid throughout the Fellowship, is mandatory. Expected to assist in teaching course(s) besides research work.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting. Interview. Mere fulfilling of eligibility criteria will not entitle any candidate to be called for interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initially for one year with the possibility of extension for another year based on satisfactory performance. Thesis-submitted candidates must submit the provisional/degree certificate within 6 months from appointment, else the appointment will stand cancelled or a decision will be taken in consultation with the thesis processing authority.

faq.answer: Department of Biological Sciences, IISER Bhopal.
